title: Algebraize the finite structure algebras with their quotient reduction maps
statement: Let A be a Noetherian I-adically complete ring, S = Spec A, X -> S separated and of finite type, X_n = X times_S Spec(A/I^(n+1)), j_n : X_n -> X the canonical closed immersions. Suppose finite f_n : Y_n -> X_n and g_n : Y_n -> Y_(n+1) form cartesian transition squares, and Y_0 -> Spec(A/I) is proper. Write r_n = f_n followed by j_n, and fix the induced equalities g_n followed by r_(n+1) = r_n. There is a sheaf B of commutative O_X-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], whose underlying module is quasi-coherent and coherent [pqf-def-coherent] and has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], together with O_X-algebra morphisms b_n : B -> r_(n,*)(O_Yn). For every affine open U of X, b_n(U) is surjective and its kernel is the ideal generated in B(U) by the image under O_X(U) -> B(U) of ker(O_X(U) -> O_Xn(j_n inverse U)). For every open U, b_(n+1)(U) followed by g_n sharp, with domains identified by the fixed equality, equals b_n(U).

proof.text: Construct the canonical transition immersions i_n and their two projection equations. Construct c_n from tensorPullbackComp. Each X_n and Y_n is locally Noetherian by finite-type permanence.

Put F_n=p_{n,*}O_{Y_n}. Finite pushforward gives coherence. The affine base-change map followed by pullback of the unit is invertible, by affinePushforward_baseChange and tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso. Use this as phi_n.

Apply finite_structure_proper_support to p_0 and X_0 -> Spec(A/I). Apply the existence clause of grothendieck_existence to F_n and phi_n. Obtain G, its coherence, proper support, psi_n and their compatibility.

Apply finite_structure_algebra_lift to G and psi_n. Transport quasi-coherence along the module isomorphism. Transport finite local generators using ofEpi on each restriction; the coherence criterion gives coherence of B. The stalk functor carries the module isomorphism to linear equivalences, preserving subsingleton stalks and therefore proper support.

For each affine chart choose the quotient ring equivalence furnished by the lift. Surjectivity of the quotient map and that equivalence proves surjectivity of b_n. Its injectivity, preservation of zero and Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem give the kernel equality. The supplied compatibility is exactly the final compatibility clause.
